All 1660 applied releases still current in the public catalog verify; 14 preexisting browse gaps remain explicit failures; 4 exact reads and 90 historical baseline checks are unavailable. No production moderation or artifact changes.

categoryDefinitions.label: Channels
categoryDefinitions.description: Human-agent messaging transports and channel adapters. Choose this when the main purpose is letting people talk to the agent through a messaging service, even if the adapter also exposes workspace tools.

categoryDefinitions.label: Models
categoryDefinitions.description: General model providers, inference backends, and model routing. Agent execution engines belong in Agent runtimes; specialized speech or media generators belong in Voice or Media when that is their main purpose.

categoryDefinitions.label: Agent runtimes
categoryDefinitions.description: Agent execution engines and backends that run model/tool loops and manage native sessions, including Codex, ACP, and Copilot runtimes. Context assembly belongs in Context; coordinating work across agents belongs in Agent orchestration.

categoryDefinitions.label: Memory
categoryDefinitions.description: Durable agent memory, embeddings, and retrieval across conversations. Building or compacting the active conversation context belongs in Context.

categoryDefinitions.label: Context
categoryDefinitions.description: Building, selecting, compacting, or managing the active conversation context. Durable memory belongs in Memory; an engine that runs the agent and owns its native sessions belongs in Agent runtimes.

categoryDefinitions.label: Voice
categoryDefinitions.description: Speech synthesis, transcription, voice calls, and spoken interaction. Music and general media creation or analysis belong in Media.

categoryDefinitions.label: Web
categoryDefinitions.description: General web search, browser control, and fetching web pages. A tool whose main purpose is a specific research or business workflow belongs in that workflow's category.

categoryDefinitions.label: Media
categoryDefinitions.description: Creating, transforming, or understanding images, video, music, and other media. Spoken interaction and transcription belong in Voice.

categoryDefinitions.label: Security
categoryDefinitions.description: Protecting access and enforcing trust through authentication, authorization, credential controls, security auditing, or policy. Authentication incidental to another purpose does not belong here.

categoryDefinitions.label: Integrations
categoryDefinitions.description: General connectors, API bridges, and service integration platforms without a more specific user purpose. A connector to a particular workflow belongs in that workflow's category; exposing tools or MCP is not enough.

categoryDefinitions.label: Developer tools
categoryDefinitions.description: Writing, reviewing, testing, and debugging software, development environments, and coding workflows. Plugins whose main purpose is providing the agent execution engine belong in Agent runtimes.

categoryDefinitions.label: Infrastructure
categoryDefinitions.description: Deploying, hosting, monitoring, and operating systems, networks, services, and execution environments. Engines that run the agent loop belong in Agent runtimes; coordinating agents belongs in Agent orchestration.

categoryDefinitions.label: Documents & files
categoryDefinitions.description: Reading, creating, extracting, transferring, and managing documents and files. Software code review belongs in Developer tools; task and project management belongs in Productivity.

categoryDefinitions.label: Inbox & collaboration
categoryDefinitions.description: Managing email, inboxes, team communication, and collaborative workspaces. Providing a transport for people to talk to the agent belongs in Channels.

categoryDefinitions.label: Productivity
categoryDefinitions.description: Managing tasks, notes, projects, plans, and personal or team work. Appointments and availability belong in Scheduling; document processing belongs in Documents & files.

categoryDefinitions.label: Scheduling
categoryDefinitions.description: Calendars, appointments, availability, and booking. Technical job scheduling belongs with the workflow it supports, or Infrastructure for general system scheduling.

categoryDefinitions.label: Finance & payments
categoryDefinitions.description: Payments, billing, accounting, banking, trading, and financial workflows. General business reporting belongs in Data & analytics.

categoryDefinitions.label: Sales & marketing
categoryDefinitions.description: Customer relationships, sales, customer support, outreach, campaigns, and marketing operations. General email or chat management belongs in Inbox & collaboration.

categoryDefinitions.label: Data & analytics
categoryDefinitions.description: Querying databases, processing datasets, analysis, reporting, and business intelligence. Agent memory storage belongs in Memory; operational telemetry belongs in Infrastructure.

categoryDefinitions.label: Agent orchestration
categoryDefinitions.description: Coordinating agents, delegating work, and running multi-step agent workflows. Engines and backends that execute the agent loop and manage its native sessions belong in Agent runtimes.

categoryDefinitions.label: Research
categoryDefinitions.description: Investigating topics, evaluating sources, working with scientific literature, and synthesizing evidence. General web search, browsing, and page fetching belong in Web.

categoryDefinitions.label: Other
categoryDefinitions.description: Use only when the plugin's main purpose does not fit another category or the available evidence is insufficient. Do not use this just because a plugin has several capabilities.

backend.scope: Local rehearsal using 100 production plugin snapshots; no production writes.

proposals.name: @agentmessier/openclaw-agent-messier
proposals.evidence: This plugin is primarily a specialized AgentNet venue client for managing a team in live agent-soccer matches, with autoplay and game-specific actions. It also exposes task-market venues, but its main gameplay purpose does not fit the defined workflow categories.

proposals.name: @alexbessarabenko/openclaw-max
proposals.evidence: This plugin’s primary purpose is connecting OpenClaw to MAX Messenger as a two-way messaging channel, supporting webhooks or polling, direct messages, group chats, and message delivery. Media handling, transcription, security policies, and streaming are supporting features.

proposals.name: @apify/apify-openclaw-plugin
proposals.evidence: The plugin’s primary purpose is web scraping and AI-powered data extraction through Apify Actors for market research, competitor intelligence, trend analysis, lead generation, and similar investigations. Although it integrates with an external API and can fetch web data, its main user job is conducting research and synthesizing extracted information.

proposals.name: @axonflow/openclaw
proposals.evidence: The plugin’s primary purpose is agent governance and security: enforcing policies, blocking dangerous tool calls, scanning/redacting PII, requiring approvals, and maintaining audit trails through AxonFlow.

proposals.name: @byterover/byterover
proposals.evidence: ByteRover is primarily an OpenClaw context engine: it recalls relevant curated knowledge before each model call and injects it into the assembled system prompt. Although it also provides `brv_record` for durable memory writes, active-context assembly is its main purpose.

proposals.name: @conan-scott/openclaw-fish-audio
proposals.evidence: This plugin is a Fish Audio speech provider focused on text-to-speech, voice cloning, configurable speech models, and generating voice-note audio for messaging channels.

proposals.name: @cyb3rb1ade/plur1bus-memory
proposals.evidence: The plugin’s primary purpose is durable, per-agent long-term memory. It stores conversation-derived knowledge in isolated LanceDB stores, supports recall, search, forgetting, embeddings, provenance, ACLs, and consolidation, with tools such as memory_store and memory_recall. The Obsidian view, UI, and Telegram commands are supporting features.

proposals.name: @expediagroup/expedia-openclaw
proposals.evidence: The plugin’s main purpose is live Expedia travel search: finding hotels, vacation rentals, and flights with prices, availability, and booking links. Travel search and booking do not fit a more specific listed category.

proposals.name: @gendigital/sage-openclaw
proposals.evidence: Sage is a security layer that intercepts agent tool calls for commands, file operations, and web requests. It detects malicious URLs, prompt injection, dangerous commands, sensitive file access, and supply-chain threats, then allows, prompts for approval, or blocks actions.

proposals.name: @honcho-ai/openclaw-honcho
proposals.evidence: The plugin is an OpenClaw memory backend that persists conversations, builds durable user and agent representations, migrates legacy memory files, and provides cross-session semantic search and retrieval through Honcho.

proposals.name: @jason-vaughan/openclaw-google-oauth
proposals.evidence: This plugin is a direct OAuth connector to six Google Workspace APIs, exposing Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Docs, Sheets, and Slides tools through one OpenClaw integration. OAuth is setup/access control, while the broad multi-service API bridge is the primary installation purpose.

proposals.name: @jeehou/openclaw-cursor-cli
proposals.evidence: This plugin’s primary purpose is to provide a `cursor-cli` model provider and route OpenClaw model calls through the local Cursor `cursor-agent` binary. Its catalog refresh, thinking-level mapping, and CLI streaming bridge support model inference rather than serving as the agent execution engine itself.

proposals.name: @manuelfedele/openclaw-gmail-plugin
proposals.evidence: This plugin manages Gmail and other IMAP/SMTP mailboxes: searching, reading, threading, sending, replying, updating, moving messages, and downloading attachments. Its main purpose is email and inbox management, not providing a messaging transport for agent conversations.

proposals.name: @mem0/openclaw-mem0
proposals.evidence: This plugin provides durable, cross-session agent memory through Mem0. It stores and retrieves facts, supports embeddings and vector stores, performs auto-recall and auto-capture, and includes memory consolidation, updates, deletion, and history management.

proposals.name: @natebjones/ob1-agent-memory
proposals.evidence: The plugin’s primary purpose is governed durable agent memory: recalling relevant memories before work, writing back summaries afterward, inspecting and reviewing stored memories, and tracking recall usage and provenance. Its OpenClaw tools implement cross-conversation continuity rather than active-context assembly or general integrations.

proposals.name: @nowledge/openclaw-nowledge-mem
proposals.evidence: Nowledge Mem is primarily a durable, cross-tool knowledge graph memory layer for OpenClaw. It captures conversations, distills important information into linked memories, supports semantic/graph retrieval, timelines, connections, and forgetting, with optional startup context injection.

proposals.name: @openguardrails/moltguard
proposals.evidence: MoltGuard’s primary purpose is protecting OpenClaw agents: it detects prompt injection, scans tool calls and files for risks, sanitizes secrets and PII, and blocks dangerous actions.

proposals.name: @openviking/openclaw-plugin
proposals.evidence: OpenViking is installed as OpenClaw’s context-engine plugin. Its primary lifecycle methods assemble, afterTurn, and compact build, recall, archive, and manage the active conversation context, while also supporting durable memory storage and retrieval.

proposals.name: @qverisai/qveris
proposals.evidence: QVeris connects the agent to a broad external capability ecosystem through its API. Its tools discover available tools, inspect their schemas, and call them dynamically; it is a general service/API bridge rather than a messaging channel, agent runtime, or specialized workflow.

proposals.name: @robot-inventor/discord-ignore
proposals.evidence: The plugin is specifically for controlling inbound Discord channel interactions with OpenClaw: it filters messages before agent dispatch and provides a Discord /cooldown command for temporarily suppressing channel traffic.

proposals.name: @shellbot/openclaw-pixcli
proposals.evidence: Pixcli’s primary purpose is generating and editing media: images, video, voiceover, music, sound effects, and podcasts. Its job handling, publishing, and API integration support these media-creation workflows.

proposals.name: @soimy/dingtalk
proposals.evidence: 该插件的主要用途是作为 OpenClaw 的钉钉企业机器人渠道适配器，通过 Stream 模式支持私聊、群聊、@机器人及消息收发。虽然还提供交互卡片、文件处理和多 Agent 路由等能力，但核心安装目的仍是让用户通过钉钉与代理通信。

proposals.name: @tencentdb-agent-memory/memory-tencentdb
proposals.evidence: 该插件的主要用途是为 AI Agent 提供长期记忆：自动捕获对话、提取并结构化记忆、生成用户画像，并通过 SQLite/腾讯云向量数据库进行持久化存储与检索。

proposals.name: @tensorfold/openclaw-google-workspace
proposals.evidence: This plugin is a unified connector to multiple Google Workspace APIs—Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Contacts, Tasks, and Sheets—using shared OAuth and configurable service toggles. Its main purpose is broad service integration rather than a single workflow.

proposals.name: @vauxr/openclaw
proposals.evidence: The plugin’s primary purpose is bridging Vauxr voice devices to OpenClaw: it receives device transcripts, routes them into agent sessions, and streams responses back for TTS. Device-control tools are secondary capabilities.

proposals.name: @xmoxmo/bncr
proposals.evidence: Bncr 是 OpenClaw 的频道插件，核心用途是通过 Bncr/无界客户端收发人与 Agent 的文本、媒体消息，并管理私聊、群聊及会话连接。

proposals.name: 100-percent-skill-vetter
proposals.evidence: This plugin’s main purpose is enforcing security policy around OpenClaw skill/plugin installation. It scans sources before activation, generates vetting reports, blocks critical findings, and intercepts agent tool calls that bypass the approved installation path.

proposals.name: apple-pim-cli
proposals.evidence: The plugin is primarily a macOS personal information manager for managing reminders, calendar events, contacts, and Mail.app data through native CLIs. Although it includes scheduling, email, and an inbound mail channel, its overall purpose is managing personal work and information.

proposals.name: browser-use-plugin
proposals.evidence: Provides browser automation for navigating websites, interacting with page elements, filling forms, taking screenshots, executing JavaScript, and extracting web-page data.

proposals.name: chrome-openclaw-sider
proposals.evidence: This plugin is explicitly a Chrome channel adapter connecting OpenClaw to the Sider Chrome extension, allowing users to communicate with and control OpenClaw from Sider’s sidebar. Pairing, message routing, streaming events, and attachment transfer support that transport purpose.

proposals.name: claude-code-sync
proposals.evidence: This plugin adopts and exposes Claude Code sessions inside OpenClaw, supports riding/resuming those native sessions, and controls active drivers with claims, locks, and relay behavior. Its primary purpose is managing access to an agent runtime's sessions, not providing a messaging channel or general integration.

proposals.name: clawlink-plugin
proposals.evidence: ClawLink is a general integration hub connecting OpenClaw to 1,000+ external apps through managed OAuth and a uniform tool interface. Its primary purpose is bridging APIs and services, rather than serving one specific workflow.

proposals.name: database
proposals.evidence: This plugin provides local SQLite database management: schema inspection, SQL querying and execution, transactions, and CRUD operations. Its main purpose is working with structured data, rather than general file management or infrastructure.

proposals.name: douyin-insights-openclaw-plugin
proposals.evidence: 该插件的主要用途是对抖音进行社媒研究与情报分析：搜索热榜、作品和达人，获取作品详情、评论、达人资料及作品/短剧合集。它是只读的研究工具，不提供发布、互动或账号运营功能。

proposals.name: email
proposals.evidence: The plugin’s primary purpose is managing email inboxes and messages through IMAP/SMTP: listing mailboxes, searching and reading messages, updating flags, moving mail, sending, and replying. This is general email and inbox management, not a messaging transport or a generic integration.

proposals.name: excel
proposals.evidence: Provides tools to inspect and edit local .xlsx workbooks, including reading sheets, replacing sheet contents, and appending rows.

proposals.name: gc-provider
proposals.evidence: This plugin primarily provides an OpenAI-compatible GrowthCircle.id model provider, registering the `growthcircle` provider and configuring model access across multiple clients. Its setup CLI is supporting functionality for connecting those clients to the inference backend.

proposals.name: google-ads-assistant
proposals.evidence: The plugin’s primary purpose is managing Google Ads campaigns: performance reporting, keyword research, search-term optimization, ad-copy creation, campaign structure, and preview-then-execute advertising edits. Its MCP connection is incidental to this marketing workflow.

proposals.name: hirey
proposals.evidence: Hirey AI primarily connects OpenClaw to the Hirey/Hi platform by registering its tools, agent-event claim service, and webhook ingress in the gateway. Its matching workflows are exposed through this service integration rather than constituting a messaging channel, agent runtime, or orchestration engine.

proposals.name: hivemind
proposals.evidence: Hivemind’s primary purpose is cloud-backed persistent shared memory: it auto-captures conversations, recalls relevant memories across sessions and agents, and shares them across teammates and workspaces.

proposals.name: holo-wechat-mp
proposals.evidence: Provides an end-to-end WeChat Official Account workflow for producing, typesetting, managing, and publishing articles, including drafts, publication status, audience statistics, and promotional content assets.

proposals.name: imclaw
proposals.evidence: IMClaw is primarily an Agent-to-Agent instant messaging channel extension. It provides direct and group messaging, media delivery, inbound message handling, and proactive sending through the `imclaw` channel; its social, profile, and contact tools support that messaging transport.

proposals.name: lobu
proposals.evidence: Lobu provides persistent, structured agent memory over MCP, including searching and saving memories. Its autoRecall and autoCapture features retrieve relevant facts before prompts and store observations for use across sessions.

proposals.name: memsearch
proposals.evidence: MemSearch provides durable cross-session memory: it summarizes and stores conversation history, indexes it with Milvus embeddings, and retrieves relevant past context through semantic search and recall tools.

proposals.name: message-linter
proposals.evidence: The plugin’s main purpose is managing and normalizing outgoing message content before dispatch, including Markdown cleanup, kaomoji-safe formatting, and Chinese text conversion. Although it uses OpenClaw message hooks and targets Discord presentation, it is a message-formatting utility rather than a human-agent transport.

proposals.name: octo
proposals.evidence: The plugin’s primary purpose is connecting OpenClaw to Octo as a real-time messaging channel via WebSocket. Its manifest identifies it as an Octo channel plugin, with bot accounts, tokens, group mentions, and message/card sending capabilities.

proposals.name: ocuclaw
proposals.evidence: OcuClaw primarily connects OpenClaw to Even Realities G2 smart glasses, providing the user-facing glasses client/relay and interactive HUD surfaces for agent interaction. Speech-to-text and session tools are supporting features.

proposals.name: openclaw-ai-video-editor
proposals.evidence: This plugin’s primary purpose is autonomous AI video editing: creating, transforming, analyzing, captioning, compositing, enhancing, and exporting video and related audio/image media through natural-language requests.

proposals.name: openclaw-browser-automation
proposals.evidence: This plugin’s main purpose is controlling Chrome/Chromium through CDP for browser automation, including opening pages, reading content, clicking, filling forms, screenshots, and tab management.

proposals.name: openclaw-code-agent
proposals.evidence: The plugin’s primary purpose is coordinating multiple coding-agent sessions: launching, monitoring, approving, resuming, stopping, and routing work across Claude Code, Codex, and OpenCode. It also manages worktrees, merges, PR follow-through, and goal loops. It is not itself the underlying agent execution engine.

proposals.name: openclaw-memory-graph
proposals.evidence: The plugin’s primary purpose is durable agent memory: it automatically extracts entities and relationships from conversations, persists them in a local SQLite knowledge graph across sessions, and provides retrieval, search, path, semantic, and temporal-memory tools.

proposals.name: openclaw-plugin-heygen
proposals.evidence: This plugin adds HeyGen as a provider for OpenClaw’s video_generate tool, specializing in avatar/presenter video generation with scripted narration, voices, styles, and image references.

proposals.name: openclaw-seatalk
proposals.evidence: This plugin is primarily a SeaTalk messaging channel adapter, enabling bidirectional private, group, and thread conversations between users and the agent. Webhook, WebSocket, relay, access control, and history tools support that human-agent messaging purpose.

proposals.name: openclaw-weixin
proposals.evidence: 该插件的主要用途是通过腾讯 iLink Bot API 将微信个人账号接入 OpenClaw，使用户能够收发文字、图片、视频、文件和语音消息；清单也明确将其标为 channel。

proposals.name: sequential-thinking
proposals.evidence: Provides a `sequential_thinking` tool for structured, reflective problem-solving, including thought history, revisions, branching, and per-session state. It is not an agent runtime, context manager, memory system, or orchestration engine, and no more specific category covers a general reasoning aid.

proposals.name: web-search-plus-plugin-v2
proposals.evidence: The plugin’s primary purpose is source-only web search and URL extraction with research mode, provenance, freshness controls, authority reranking, quality reports, and multi-provider routing. Although it integrates many search services, those are implementation details supporting web research rather than the main installation purpose.

proposals.name: xhs-insights-openclaw-plugin
proposals.evidence: Provides Xiaohongshu social-media marketing research tools: hot-list, note, product, review, creator, topic, and comment analysis/search. Its primary purpose is researching audiences, products, creators, and content for marketing workflows.

held.reason: Session discovery, driver locks and relay: README identifies the gateway half and advisory spawn, without an agent execution engine to support Agent runtimes.

browserVerification.reportMarkdown:
Captured in real Chromium on the agent host after waiting for the exact expected plugin identities, not only result counts. Desktop viewport: 1440×1080; mobile: 390×844. These are actual application screenshots; source pixels were not composed or edited.

Developer tools changes from **8 to 3** results. Three native runtimes move into Agent runtimes; Code Agent separately moves into Agent orchestration, and the held Claude Code Sync proposal retains original production metadata. The new Agent runtimes filter shows **Codex, ACPX and Copilot** with its Bot category icon. New-category desktop/mobile captures are **candidate-only**, since the v2 category list has no matching category.

ClawHub rendered at `http://127.0.0.1:4320/plugins`. Paired full-page captures show category navigation, Developer tools, and mobile Inbox & collaboration (2 → 3 results). Candidate-only captures show Agent runtimes at desktop and mobile widths.

Capture boundaries:

- Developer tools filter: Full-page screenshots of /plugins?category=developer-tools. Three native runtimes moved; Code Agent reclassified to orchestration; held Claude Code Sync retained original metadata.
- Mobile Inbox & collaboration: Same /plugins?category=inbox-collaboration filter. Full page.
- Agent runtimes filter (candidate only): New category; no prior equivalent screenshot.
